Link

Bitcoin fell to roughly $77,000 from highs near $79,300, crude oil jumped nearly 2–2.3%, and Coinglass recorded about $180M in crypto liquidations, mostly longs, within an hour.
Matters because: This is a clear negative catalyst for risk assets if tensions continue, though the initial reaction has been contained relative to prior shocks.

Just dropped a research note on SEO vs AEO.
Here’s your TL;DR ↓
–
BrightEdge
says AI Overviews now appear on ~48% of tracked queries, and the block is tall enough to push #1 organic below the first scroll.
–
Pew
found clicks to traditional results fall to 8% from 15% when an AI Overview appears;
Ahrefs
saw a 58% drop in #1 organic CTR.
– AI-referred visitors convert at 4.4x the rate of traditional organic traffic.
–
Gartner
ʼs 25% search-volume drop by 2026 hasn't happened yet – Google still holds over 90% share, and chat queries cost about 10x more to serve.
–
Ahrefs
says Google AI Overview overlap with top-10 organic fell from 76% to 38%; for ChatGPT/Gemini/Copilot it is only about 12%.
–
Promptwatch
tracked a 95% drop in Reddit citations in ChatGPT after one model update – not a very stable channel.
– The market is hot: Profound is at a $1B valuation, and Adobe agreed to buy Semrush for about $1.9B.
– The sober read: a
recent review
found only 2 studies with real traffic/conversion data; one benchmark even showed body-text optimization reducing citations by 6-9%.
